title: Lending of securities bought in the Indian Market
text: Lending of securities bought in the Indian Market Oct 20, 2008| Circulars Deputy General Manager Division of Foreign Institutional Investors & Custodians Investment Management Department Cir No.IMD/FII&C/34/2008 October 20, 2008 To All Foreign Institutional Investors through their designated Custodians of Securities Sub:- Lending of securities bought in the Indian Market. SEBI has reviewed the data submitted by the foreign institutional investors in pursuance of our circular no.32, dated October 16, 2008. SEBI disapproves of the activity of the foreign institutional investors lending shares abroad. The facility of lending and borrowing has been made available on Indian Exchanges. SEBI is reworking the existing stock exchange offered securities lending and borrowing mechanism, to make suitable changes. The custodians are requested to communicate to their FII constituents the disapproval of SEBI as stated above. This circular is available on our website https://www.sebi.gov.in. Yours faithfully, Jeevan Sonparote
